name: Lower Notch Berry Farm
description: Lower Notch Berry Farm is a family-run farm in 947 Lower Notch Road, VT. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
